rights_and_task_review.content_origin: 10 synthetic Japanese receipt images and matching public structured source records. Source card says no real receipts, transactions, people, brands or reference images.
rights_and_task_review.student_task: Prototype a receipt reader for organizing school-festival expenses: use OCR to read item names and prices, then compare totals with structured examples.
task_limits: This is not a full-text OCR transcription benchmark; only structured item and total examples are provided.
Only 10 synthetic clean samples; results do not generalize to all receipts.
Never use OCR alone for actual bookkeeping or financial decisions.
Do not upload real receipts with personal information to a public notebook.
